title: GMMF membership of a fixed ternary bent function
summary: Determine whether a specific six-variable ternary non-weakly regular bent function belongs to the generalized Maiorana--McFarland class.

formal_statement.body: Let $\lambda$ denote the primitive element of $\mathbb F_{3^6}$ selected in source Example 4, and let $$f(x)=\operatorname{Tr}_1^6(\lambda x^{20}+\lambda^{41}x^{92}).$$ Does this fixed function $f$ belong to the generalized Maiorana--McFarland (GMMF) class under the source definition? Give an explicit GMMF representation of $f$, or prove that no such representation exists.

scope.domain: Ternary bent functions and generalized Maiorana--McFarland constructions
assumptions: $\lambda$ is the primitive element selected in source Example 4
GMMF membership uses the definition fixed by the source
scope.unresolved_remainder: No inspected later work gives a GMMF representation for the displayed function or proves that it lies outside GMMF.

citations.label: Ozbudak--Pelen, fixed ternary GMMF membership question

progress.summary: Remark 7 states that membership of the displayed ternary bent function in GMMF is unknown.
